messages:
sasha: heads up — after pushing helios7b 4bit-q rollout to prod we’re seeing two things: date hallucinations on long-context prompts and a ~25% p99 tail increase on gpu-pool-b. Not a crash, but QA flagged it. Repro in canary. Anyone else seeing this?

ajay: can you paste a repro prompt and the smallest log snippet? also: is this only on q4_0 or across q4 variants?

sasha: repro prompt (shortened):
```
Prompt: "Summarize the timeline and dates for the following events: ... (long transcript, ~1.5k tokens)"
Output sample: "March 3, 2025March 3, 2025 — The committee met on March 3, 2025..."
```
Logs (canary agent):
```
[2026-03-20 16:02:12] INFO infer: model=helios7b cfg=q4_0 batch=1 seq=1536 p99=86ms
[2026-03-20 16:02:12] WARN kvcache: rewound entries != kv_len (expected 1536 got 1532)
[2026-03-20 16:02:13] ERROR token_gen: repeated token detected x2 at step 12
```

deploy-bot: canary status: helios7b q4_0 -> traffic 10% (10/100). errors 0.4% vs baseline 0.1%. rolling window 5m. snapshot: release-helm/helios7b-2026-03-20-2475001200.tar.gz

maria: thanks for the details. sounds like a quantization path regression (per-channel vs per-tensor scaling mismatch) or a KV-cache alignment bug after fused-attn path for 4bit. immediate mitigation: route production traffic to fp16-compat variant and demote q4_0 until triage. also add a short eval that checks date formatting and token-repeat on the postlaunch suite.

kevin: this matches a QKV scaling bug we saw in april last year with another model — fused attention kernel using wrong scale when running fused QKV int path. quick debug: run `python tools/quant_debug.py --model helios7b --cfg q4_0 --step 8 --dump-qkv` and compare q/k/v norms vs fp16 parity. if mismatch -> kernel bug.

ajay: i'll run parity diffs now between fp16, q4_0(per-tensor), q4_0(per-channel) on the canary snapshot. will enable kvcache=True/False to see if replay/rewind logic triggers duplication. will report diffs and attach token-level divergence histogram.

sasha: customer impact: two platform customers reported duplicated dates and occasional duplicated small tokens ("waswas"). Not widespread but fails a bunch of our date-parsing downstream tests. planning a rollback at 16:30 PT if we can't produce a patch.

kevin: i'll instrument fused-attn and try a local repro. if i can reproduce, i'll push hotfix to branch candidate/helios7b-fused-fix and request canary redeploy. otherwise rollback.

deploy-bot: snapshot created: artifacts/helios7b-canary-snap-2475001210.tar.gz; pinned to job deploy/helios7b-canary-2475001212

maria: adding to postlaunch checklist items: 1) date-format/regression evals, 2) token-repeat detector (basic ngram repetition), 3) p99 perf monitor for 4-bit rollouts, 4) parity-diff coverage for kvcache enabled runs.

sasha: :thumbsup: thanks. ajay — drop the parity artifacts link here. kevin — ping me when you have a failing unit test or the patch. rolling back at 16:30 PT if no green.

ajay: on it, starting parity runs. will share S3 link in ~12–15 minutes.

kevin: will attempt repro now, will post results in this thread.

sasha: noted — keeping the rollback window open.
